title: Federated Learning of Nonlinear Temporal Dynamics with Graph Attention-based Cross-Client Interpretability
abstract: arXiv:2602.13485v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Networks of modern industrial systems are increasingly monitored by distributed sensors, where each system comprises multiple subsystems that generate high-dimensional time-series. These subsystems are often interdependent, making it important to understand how temporal patterns observed at one subsystem relate to those observed across others. This problem is particularly challenging in decentralized settings where raw measurements cannot be shared, and client observations are heterogeneous. Moreover, in practice, each subsystem (client) operates a fixed, proprietary model that cannot be modified or retrained, limiting the applicability of existing approaches. Separately, nonlinear dynamics make cross-client temporal interdependencies difficult to characterize, as they are embedded implicitly within nonlinear state-transition functions. translated_title: 基于图注意力实现跨客户端可解释性的非线性时间动态联邦学习
translated_abstract: 现代工业系统的网络日益由分布式传感器进行监测，每个系统由多个子系统组成，这些子系统生成高维时间序列。这些子系统之间往往相互依赖，因此理解在一个子系统中观察到的时间模式与其他子系统中观察到的时间模式之间的关系至关重要。这一问题在去中心化环境中尤其具有挑战性，因为原始测量数据无法共享，且客户端的观测数据是异构的。此外，在实际应用中，每个子系统（客户端）运行着一个固定的、专有的模型，该模型无法被修改或重新训练，这限制了现有方法的适用性。另外，非线性动态使得跨客户端的时间相互依赖关系难以刻画，因为它们隐式地嵌入在非线性状态转移函数之中。本文提出了一种垂直联邦学习框架，用于学习一步前瞻的跨客户端时间动态……
tldr: 本文提出一种垂直联邦学习框架，在原始数据不可共享、客户端观测异构且各客户端模型固定不可重训的约束下，利用图注意力机制实现跨客户端的非线性时间动态一步预测，并具备跨客户端可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a vertical federated learning framework that leverages graph attention to achieve cross-client interpretability for one-step-ahead prediction of nonlinear temporal dynamics, under constraints of non-shareable raw data, heterogeneous client observations, and fixed, non-retrainable proprietary client models.
